interfaces: diagnostic { code, taskId, dependencyId, sourcePath, reason, cycle }

behavioralConstraints: input tasks must come from schema-validated task registry records
dependencies are prerequisites and must appear before dependents in taskOrder
diagnostics are sorted deterministically before exposure
missing references and self-dependencies are validation failures
resolution refuses partial graph output when validation diagnostics exist
satisfaction uses only explicit satisfiedTaskIds input
direct blockers identify immediate unsatisfied dependencies
disconnected components are valid and ordered deterministically
invariants: no assignment or lock mutation occurs
no GitHub or agent-provider calls occur
examples: chain A to B to C resolves in dependency order
diamond dependencies resolve before their shared dependent
two independent DAG components are valid
missing references self-dependencies and cycles fail with actionable diagnostics
edgeCases: empty registry resolves to empty maps
multi-node cycle reports a cycle path
unsatisfied transitive dependencies are exposed separately from direct blockers

expectations: invalid dependency graphs fail before task selection begins
blocked tasks expose unsatisfied direct dependencies
